gallery.filename: Killalpaninna Mission, view of lake showing windmill and church(GN00423).jpg
gallery.title: File:Killalpaninna Mission, view of lake showing windmill and church(GN00423).jpg
gallery.description:
Killalpannina Mission,  view of lake showing windmill and buildings, far north-east South Australia. 
This is the first church Lutheran Missionaries built at Lake Killalpaninna in the far north-east of South Australia. The Lutherans called the Lake Killalpaninna mission, 'Hermannsburg', predating the mission of the same name and which is located in the Northern Territory.

See Christobel Mattingley and Ken Hampton, 'Survival In Our Own Land', pp. 189-194.
